name: Auto Ping Booster
author: Samee Ullah Feroz

sections.description:
Auto Ping Booster (by PingBooster Agency) is a lightweight indexing and metadata toolkit for WordPress. It notifies IndexNow-compatible services when public content is published or updated. A notification requests discovery; it does not guarantee crawling, indexing, or ranking.

Learn more about full indexing solutions at PingBooster.site.

Free Features:

  • IndexNow Notifications: Automatically queue URL notifications when public content is published or updated.
  • Manual IndexNow Submission: Submit URLs from your own website to the IndexNow endpoint.
  • XML Sitemap: Publish posts, pages, products, categories, and tags in a lightweight sitemap.
  • Webmaster Verification: Add verification codes for Google, Bing, Yandex, and Baidu.
  • Robots Rules: Append custom directives and the enabled sitemap URL to WordPress virtual robots.txt.
  • Custom Meta & Canonical Controls: Full meta box controls in post, page, and WooCommerce product editors to customize SEO titles, descriptions, and canonical URLs.
  • Live Search Snippet Preview: Real-time Google SERP preview as you write your meta titles and descriptions.
  • Migration and Backup: Import supported metadata from Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or AIOSEO and import/export plugin settings.

🚀 Upgrade to Auto Ping Booster Pro:

Take your site’s indexing performance and search engine ranking speed to the next level with Auto Ping Booster Pro. Unlock advanced indexing features at https://pingbooster.site/plugins/auto-ping-booster-pro/

  • Unlimited API URL Instant Broadcasts: Index hundreds or thousands of pages with priority queued bulk pinging.
  • Advanced Rich Snippets & Schema Markup: Automatic structured data markup for high-CTR SERP listings.
  • Automated Slug & Canonical Optimization: Smart auto-cleaners for duplicate URL structures and permalinks.
  • Live Google Analytics 4 (GA4) Integration: Track organic click-through rates and search query analytics directly inside your WordPress dashboard.
  • Advanced Automation and Reporting: Access additional workflow, monitoring, and optimization tools.

👉 Get Pro Access & Documentation: https://pingbooster.site/plugins/auto-ping-booster-pro/

External services

This plugin connects to api.indexnow.org when you manually submit URLs or when queued automatic notifications run. It sends your site hostname, the public IndexNow key and key location, and the URLs you choose or publish. See the IndexNow terms and privacy information.

The News & Updates admin page requests a feed from pingbooster.site. The request includes the plugin version and your public site URL in the user-agent so the service can diagnose compatibility and abuse. See the PingBooster privacy policy.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the auto-ping-booster directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory (or search and install via Plugins > Add New).
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Ping Booster in your WordPress admin sidebar to configure IndexNow and related options.
  4. For detailed setup guides and API tutorials, visit PingBooster Documentation.
sections.faq:
How does PingBooster speed up indexing?

Auto Ping Booster sends URL notifications to the IndexNow API. Participating search engines decide when and whether to crawl or index the URL.

Does Auto Ping Booster slow down my post publishing?

Automatic IndexNow notifications are queued through WordPress Cron so publishing does not wait for the remote request.

Does this guarantee Google indexing or higher rankings?

No. The plugin helps discovery through IndexNow and site metadata, but no plugin can guarantee indexing or rankings.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

You can view plan comparisons and activate your Pro license key directly at Auto Ping Booster.

  • Hardened JSON settings import and corrected feature descriptions.

7.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Added instant ping engine for updated and published posts.
  • Added IndexNow integration.
  • Added custom Meta Title, Description, and Canonical URL editor with live SERP preview.
  • Integrated PingBooster Pro upgrade banners and marketing module.
